```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(googlesheets4)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
fluor<- as.data.frame(read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/159QQWbnsSv8EMKSw7MRolT06qdi9TPAlmggsCe00o0Q/edit?usp=sharing"))
```

```{r}
fluor$CultureRnd <- as.character(fluor$CultureRnd)

fluor %>% ggplot(aes(x=TimePt, y= Fluor)) + geom_point(aes(color = CultureRnd))  +facet_wrap(~Species+Incubator, scales = "free_y") + theme_bw() + scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma())
```


```{r}
View((fluor %>% filter(Species == "Thalassiosira psuedonana") %>% filter(Incubator == "24C")))

```
